BEIT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the B1-2 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown

on Map No. 5-F in an area bound by:

West Armitage Avenue; aline 76.95 feet southeast of West Armitage Avenue as measured along the east

right-of-way line of North Lincoln Avenue and perpendicular thereto; and North Lincoln Avenue.

To those of a C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District

SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property 345 W Armitage Ave.
